title: Fanuc M-900iB/700｜多源合并
ownership: brand package maintains module; standard library publishes fixed mechanical representations

composition.scope: Selected reusable assembly only; site installation and station coordination belong to domain package

auxiliary_linkage.scope: offline kinematic replay; physical loop closure and dynamics not qualified
auxiliary_linkage.update_order: Update six driven link world transforms, then evaluate all dependent auxiliary frames; inputs column-vector transforms in metres

controller_consumer_contract.domain: Inverse-map USD targets and check original lower/upper; axis enclosures alone are insufficient
controller_consumer_contract.input: source controller degrees in serialized joint order
controller_consumer_contract.si_backend: Convert degrees to radians at OS runtime boundary; do not pass coupled USD coordinates as independent controller inputs
controller_consumer_contract.usd_coordinates: controller_coordinate_matrix @ source_input; signed axes already represented by USD frames

auxiliary_linkage.assembly_branch: positive displacement along normalized ((B-A) cross source link2 Z)
auxiliary_linkage.scope: source graphical four-bar closure; infeasible/singular triangles rejected; no dynamics qualification

controller_constraint.formula: usd_joint_degrees = matrix @ source_controller_degrees; signed axes encoded in joint frames
controller_constraint.limits_scope: USD limits are per-axis enclosure only. Coupled domain requires inverse(matrix) @ usd_coordinates within original source limits; dynamics remains disabled

native_static_provenance.authority: static PE instructions and bounded Ghidra decompilation; no vendor execution
native_static_provenance.base_application: First returned graphical link pose is the base transform; subsequent poses postmultiply MDH
native_static_provenance.units: source XYZ millimeters and Rx/Ry/Rz radians; joints degrees

robot_parameters.units: MDH alpha/theta radians, a/d millimeters; input joints degrees
